_comment: Adventurers Guild tuning. Rank index 0..5 = E..S. Live-reload in game: AG_Native.ReloadConfig (DevBench: call AG_Native ReloadConfig '[]').
_promotionFee: Gold the Guild charges to process a promotion (shown in the dialogue option).
_cardReplacementFee: The first guild card is free (handed over at registration; a member from before 1.2.0 gets theirs on loading). Gold for a replacement after that, asked of any Guild liaison (only offered while you carry no card).
_promotion: Promotion to rank N needs guild Reputation >= reputation[N] AND the level of that rank. Reputation is standing: earned from missives, dungeon reports and kills, never spent. The levels are not set here: they follow the level of rank S (MCM > System > Level for rank S; [Ranks] in AdventurersGuild.ini for a new game), the same table that ranks threats, dungeons and other adventurers, so a rank-X adventurer is at least a rank-X threat. Apply at any innkeeper once eligible.
_party: Adventuring parties (docs/PARTIES.md). fee: gold to found a party at a counter. maxMembers: companions besides the player, at most 9 (a party is never more than 10, however many followers a follower mod allows). nameMaxLength: characters in a party name. bondTiers: the Bond (0-100, averaged over active members) at which Strangers, Companions, Comrades, Sworn and Legend start.
_partyBond: Bond each member present gains (present = an active member who is alive, following you and loaded in the area with you; nothing grows with no member present). perFieldHour: per in-game hour in the field together (a jump bigger than maxTickHours between checks - waiting, sleeping, fast travel - is not field time). kill: per foe your side kills, by its threat rank E..S, x bigKill for dragons, giants and bosses, at most killDailyCap per member per day. dungeon / missive: per clear or completed missive, by rank E..S. Every gain shrinks as Bond rises: x (1 - bond / diminish), at least x0.2.

party._renown: How far the party's name travels (SkyrimNet: who has heard of it). Points: 3 per dungeon cleared and per missive, 5 per great beast or boss, 0.2 per kill, 1 per day in the field together. At renown[0] NPCs everywhere know the party's name ('talked about in the holds'); at renown[1] it is famous across Skyrim. Guild reps and the party's own members always know it.

_conduct: What costs Reputation. Only what the holds know: when your bounty in a hold RISES the Guild hears of it and takes repPerBountyGold of Reputation for each gold of it (0.1: a 40 gold assault costs 4, a 1000 gold murder 100). A rise too small to cost a whole point is carried over to the next, so many petty thefts cost what one theft of the same total does. A crime nobody witnessed costs nothing. While you have a bounty anywhere, promotion is on hold; paying it or serving the time lifts that. A rank is never taken away, but Reputation can fall below what the next promotion needs. abandonShare: giving up or failing a missive or notice you TOOK costs this share of the Reputation it would have paid.
_registrationCap: Registration places an experienced newcomer by level (the same levels), never above this rank.
_currencies: Two currencies. Merit is spent on guild services (intel, Appraisal, training). Reputation is standing: promotion reads it and nothing spends it. Trophies pay Merit only (see trophies.json), kills Reputation only, missives and dungeon reports both. Rewards below your rank pay the same as at rank.
_missiveMerit: Paid when a completed Missive's report is handed in, by the missive's rank.
_notDungeons: Places the game marks as clearable that are not dungeons, so the Guild does not announce them, sell dungeon intel on them or pay for clearing them (they can still be Points of Interest, below). 'Plugin|0xID' of the location. Shipped: Stendarr's Beacon and the Hall of the Vigilant (both held by the Vigilants of Stendarr). Add another mod's peaceful place here if it gets a dungeon notice.
_pointsOfInterest: Intel's second tab: places worth knowing that are not dungeons. Found from the game's map markers, so places added by other mods count. A category takes every marker with one of its 'markers' icons (Camp, Shipwreck, Grove, Landmark, Doomstone, ImperialTower, Lighthouse, OrcStronghold, Shack, Shrine, ...) plus the 'places' named outright ('Plugin|0xID' of the map marker reference); the first category that fits wins, and 'merit' is its one price. A marker whose location is a dungeon stays on the Dungeons tab unless it is named in 'places'. Only places not yet on the player's map are offered, for the hold the counter is in. 'never': markers the Guild does not sell whatever their icon (places only the main quest reaches, hidden factions, docks drawn with a shipwreck icon). enabled false removes the tab.
_dungeonMerit: Paid for reporting a cleared dungeon, by the dungeon's threat rank (once per dungeon per save, quest or not).
_dungeonGold: Gold the Guild pays for the same report.
_intelMerit: Merit to buy a dungeon's location at the counter (Services > Intel), by its threat rank. Only dungeons at or below the player's guild rank are listed.
_kills: Reputation credited the moment a hostile foe dies, by its threat rank (level band plus the creature adjustment in AdventurersGuild.ini [Threat]). Big game pays more, by the engine's race size class (mods set it for their creatures too): Large (centurions, cave bears, atronachs) largeMultiplier, Extra Large (dragons, giants, mammoths) extraLargeMultiplier. A foe placed as a dungeon Boss pays bossMultiplier. The highest multiplier applies, never the product. Your kill pays in full; a follower's or your summon's kill pays followerShare; if someone else (a guard, a bystander) finishes a foe your side hit in the last assistSeconds, that assist pays assistShare. Never paid twice. Summoned or reanimated foes pay nothing. Silent: no HUD line per kill.
_appraisal: Appraisal is a passive Guild skill bought at the counter. Without it no rank labels are shown. Appraisal I reads people and wildlife; creatures of legend show [?] until Appraisal II, and any threat of rank A or S until Appraisal III ([Appraisal] in AdventurersGuild.ini). Index 0..2 = Appraisal I..III. sellBonus (percent, merchants pay you more) is baked into the ESP perks by tools/EspGen; trophyBonus (percent extra Merit on trophies) is applied by the DLL. Appraisal III also reveals hidden ranks.
_modCreatureTrophies: Parts of creatures other mods add. The trophy list (trophies.json) names vanilla monster parts; these are found from the game's records instead: an ingredient, or a misc item tagged as an animal hide or part, that another mod defines and that a creature which starts fights (Aggressive or worse) carries or drops. Harmless wildlife adds nothing, and meat is never a trophy. Merit = the item's gold value / goldPerMerit, between 1 and maxMerit. A creature carrying more than maxPartsPerCreature different parts is carrying loot (a Falmer alchemist's ingredients), and none of it counts. An item with one of the notTrophies words in its name is food, never a trophy (add your language's words if you play in another language). Set enabled to false to buy only the listed trophies.
